title: Simulation 3D Message Get
text: Retrieve data from Unreal Engine visualization environment, 1 output, {Sample time} sets Sample time; {Signal name, SigName} sets the message signal name, {Data type, DataType} sets the message data type and {Message size, MsgSize} sets the message dimension. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ReadMsg
ports.summary: Data retrieved from scene scalar | array

params.name: Data type, DataType
params.values: Message data type double * | single | int8 * | uint8 * | int16 * | uint16 * | int32 | uint32 * | boolean
